title_en: How to Request a Change of English Name in Student Academic Records
summary: Students who wish to change the English name in their academic records must submit a request with supporting documents. Enrolled students (including those on leave of absence) apply through MySNU, while graduates and students who have completed coursework (수료생) submit a correction request form and supporting documents to the Office of Academic Affairs (학사과) in person or by email. The notice states no deadline.
applies_to: Any student who wishes to change the English name in their academic record (학적). Two groups are covered: (1) enrolled students (재적생), meaning currently enrolled students and students on leave of absence; (2) graduates and students who have completed coursework without graduating (수료생). The request is made only by students who want the change; it is not mandatory for all students.
conditions: A supporting document is required in every case: one copy of your passport or of your alien registration card.
Enrolled students and students on leave apply online through MySNU, not on paper.
Graduates and students who have completed coursework must also submit a Request Form for Correction of Academic Record Entries (학적부 기재사항 정정신청서).
steps: Enrolled students and students on leave: Prepare one copy of your passport or alien registration card as a supporting document.

Enrolled students and students on leave: Log in to MySNU and go to 학사정보시스템 (Academic Information System) -> 학적변동 (Change of Academic Status) -> 신청 (Application) -> 학적부기재사항정정 (Correction of Academic Record Entries).
Enrolled students and students on leave: Submit the request with the supporting document attached.
Graduates and students who have completed coursework: Prepare one Request Form for Correction of Academic Record Entries (학적부 기재사항 정정신청서) and one copy of your passport or alien registration card.

Graduates and students who have completed coursework: Submit the form and supporting document to the Office of Academic Affairs (학사과) in person or by email; the email address is in the original notice (no room number is given).
translation:
[Common] How to Request a Change of English Name in Student Academic Records

How to request a change of the English name in academic records

Enrolled students (currently enrolled students and students on leave of absence)
- How to apply: Apply through MySNU with a supporting document attached.
- Required documents: One supporting document (a copy of your passport or a copy of your alien registration card).
- Menu: MySNU -> 학사정보시스템 (Academic Information System) -> 학적변동 (Change of Academic Status) -> 신청 (Application) -> 학적부기재사항정정 (Correction of Academic Record Entries)

Graduates and students who have completed coursework (수료생)
- How to apply: Submit the Request Form for Correction of Academic Record Entries and a supporting document to the Office of Academic Affairs (학사과).
- Required documents: One Request Form for Correction of Academic Record Entries (학적부 기재사항 정정신청서) and one supporting document (a copy of your passport or a copy of your alien registration card).
- How to submit: Visit the Office of Academic Affairs in person or submit by email (the email address is given in the original notice).
